<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Recovery:</strong> Indian indices opened higher with the Sensex gaining 400 points and Nifty reclaiming the 22,700 level, led by strength in IT stocks despite earlier concerns over FII selling and Asian market routs.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Monetary Policy Impact:</strong> The RBI has raised the repo rate to 5.5% to combat inflationary pressures, leading to increased volatility in bond yields as the central bank prioritizes rupee defense.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxQdFNWVm5Cd19SYjZXWi01WmpZcUxLX1BITGVuNjE2MEc2OUg4WmVLNWRmLS1WUkcxVnBNd1EyS0hzUVFpckF3eTgxVnRSdmZBeHZzXzRua3lTODFFYW9UbUFqVElxd1BEakJ2WmFPUFZOOXR5d2FpQk5RemI3dEdmVjBodzNfLXB6WnZXX3hYUmZkakdObDBrLVVzTUQ2bXl6U1I3MDBocFpqcXpDSE9EMzJzbU1ERzdaaVZJUllPY2lleFU?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Inflation and Energy Risks:</strong> Global sentiment remains cautious as hot US inflation data fuels rate-hike expectations, while Brent crude prices hover above $105-$106 amid ongoing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and Ukraine.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Regional Volatility:</strong> Asian markets are experiencing significant turbulence, notably a sharp decline in South Korea’s KOSPI, which continues to influence risk appetite for emerging market investors.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxOZDhtNkJPT3QtYldFb1gxZ3RaUkw2bDhTY0pWV0ZmSncxaVZwZkx3REJtSHZWSWFQM2d6TkFYckJSMDVrME9WMVpXQTZick9jYjNLYVRCcllZeXp5NGhsaVhZN2Q0dG5BTTREaUsyM0Z6Z3N1VUh0bUdGVmc2VW5FLWZncWh0ZVhXNHRfMUtKaUszLXhZNnc2U1FkX0tjSVRNUUkxc2RhNkU1MkJaTTFN?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
